message.body: Hi Grandma, it's Ethan. I changed my number, this is my new one. Can you send $300 today? I'll explain later.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Be careful: this may not be Ethan.
reasons: A new number that asks for money at once is the family scam.
Call Ethan on his usual number first.
